    msgs = apis.phone.search_text_messages(access_token=token, phone_number=spam_number, page_index=page)
    if not msgs:
        break
    for m in msgs:
        apis.phone.delete_text_message(access_token=token, text_message_id=m['text_message_id'])
    page += 1
